name: @workerv2/blueprint
description: Worker V2 Blueprint Platform — the immutable, deterministic, content-addressable representation of everything that must be produced for an album: blueprint model + graph, declarative compiler, validation (invariants: no dangling references, tree containment, stable ids, deterministic ordering), canonical serialization, hashing (identity = canonical content), schema versioning, and the diff model. Pure data + pure functions; NO execution, NO rendering, NO storage.
